g.text: An ACTIVE session leaves only through CLOSED, and only CLOSED frees the slot
(admin channel in BASE, chain tx in CHAIN)
open record not in the final log
reply to the client once it is final
CLOSED: no packet accepted. Resting orders stay unless
COD; their later records still enter the session stream.
on entering CLOSED the lane emits one last in-stream
record: Reject BAD_MAC or Reject SESSION_CLOSED
